All 67 entries are finite. `max|z|=1.914849e+274`, and
`sqrt(67)*max|z|=1.567371e+275`, proving the exact 2-norm is representable
as `double`. The new helper reports `||z||_2=1.915e+274`; the pre-fix `inf`
was intermediate square/sum overflow, not nonfinite entries or a truly
unrepresentable norm. The independent factor-system backward error is
`8.242351e-80` against a `1e-12` acceptance limit on this host.
